Initial commit
Initial commit 1.1

Implement main window functionality and enhance database integration
Adds product log search, dynamic table population, admin-only save/delete, and cascading filters. Introduces helper database utilities including column discovery, distinct value fetching, and row querying.
main window arrow, default month
Main window optimizing. Order by desc/asc
style.css added
Add product name filter, region category/tag search, and Python bcrypt hash verification tool
update to pc
before change
update_staging_serial, set_staging_serial optimization
update_staging_serial, set_staging_serial optimization

Implement new build system for DataRework and SerialStoreSync executables
Add `build.ps1` script for streamlined builds with service management, PyInstaller specification, and asset bundling. Introduce custom service management via NSSM and build-time icon generation. Update `.gitignore` to exclude build outputs and sensitive files. Refactor dotenv loading for better compatibility with frozen applications.

Add comprehensive tests for container rename functionality
Introduce `tests/_test_container_rename.py` with 49 tests covering edge cases and validation for container renaming logic. Ensure renamed containers propagate changes consistently across database tables and UI.

Add i18n support with EN/TH toggle
Introduce English and Thai translations for the application, including language toggle via `LanguageToggle` widget. Add JSON-based i18n catalogs (`locales/en.json`, `locales/th.json`) and a dynamic translation mechanism (`i18n.py`, `i18n_widgets.py`). Update UI components for language adaptability and include unit tests to validate translation functionality.

Enhance login UI and streamline theme handling
Introduce a responsive login window with improved styling via `login.css` and QSS updates. Consolidate theme-related logic into `theme.py`, retiring duplicate code from `main_window.py`. Enable server-side distinct value fetching for enhanced tag filtering and update filters UI behavior accordingly. Add new translations to support login-related text in EN/TH (`locales/en.json`, `locales/th.json`).
minor adjustment

Split `db.py` into a structured `db/` package
Refactor `db.py` into an organized package with modular submodules: `connection.py`, `auth.py`, `schema.py`, `queries.py`, `hierarchy.py`, `serial_state.py`, `edge_mirror.py`, and `containers.py`. Introduce three new helper functions (`_save_changes`, `_update_staging_serial_data`, `save_grid_changes`) to unify grid-save into a single transaction. Update `db/__init__.py` for proper re-exports while preserving API compatibility.
Add `ContainerPanel` UI and bulk delete feature; integrate with database and tests

Add product avatar support
Introduce `AvatarCatalog` for normalized product images based on packaging levels. Add `avatars.json` and `product-avatars.md` for image mappings and documentation. Update `ContainerPanel` to display avatars alongside container info. Enhance database queries to include distinct product data. Add integration tests to validate product avatar functionality.

Add non-modal product image preview
Introduce `ImagePreview` for viewing product images without blocking the UI. Add `AvatarLabel` to make product avatars interactive. Update `ContainerPanel` to support preview functionality and ensure previews persist during container refresh. Add related tests and new translations for the feature.

Add tests and improve UX for barcode rename dialog
Introduce `test_barcode_rename.py` with new test cases to validate barcode renaming flow, including keyboard scanner behavior and prefill handling. Enhance `RenameContainerDialog` UX with auto-focus logic, event filtering, placeholder texts, and delayed preview updates. Update translations to include additional text for improved guidance.

Add comprehensive DataRework workflow guide
Introduce a detailed HTML documentation covering DataRework's architecture, workflows, data contracts, queries, and proposed development extensions. Designed for developers and operators, this guide emphasizes system understanding and scalability paths. Includes responsive design, print-friendly styling, and organized sections for usability.

Add user tag propagation and tests
Extend login and main window logic to include user `tag_name` propagation. Update database changes to include operator tags, ensuring robust data tracking. Add associated tests to validate user tag integration in workflows and save operations.

Add in-memory error logging and non-modal log viewer
Introduce `debug_log.py` with an in-memory log for error tracking, featuring a non-modal `LogWindow` for viewing detailed messages and tracebacks. Update `main_window.py` to integrate error logging, replacing `print` statements with structured log entries. Enhance status updates to include traceback logs and improve error visibility. Add minor UI and style updates for the new log functionality.

Implement shared English/Thai typography and UI font scaling
Add `typography.py` to resolve a single installed font covering English and Thai text, ensuring consistent font selection across language switches without downloads. Integrate typography with `theme.py` to propagate font families and log pixel sizes into stylesheets. Update UI components and tests to reflect natural Thai shaping, button size stability, and glyph coverage validation. Adjust layouts and styles for improved multilingual text rendering adaptability.
button adjustment

Add container deletion preview, logic, and dialog
Introduce `delete_dialog.py` for reviewing containers before deletion. Add `_test_container_delete_pg.py` for validating SQL correctness and scenarios in PostgreSQL temporary tables. Implement `db/deletion.py` for logic to clean up containers and their dependencies.

Add level marks for containers and navigation history in `ContainerPanel`
Introduce visual "level marks" for each packaging level to enhance clarity. Add navigation history with breadcrumbs and Back/Forward controls for improved user navigation. Update styles, translations, and tests to support these enhancements.

Add level marks for containers and navigation history in `ContainerPanel`
Introduce visual "level marks" for each packaging level to enhance clarity. Add navigation history with breadcrumbs and Back/Forward controls for improved user navigation. Update styles, translations, and tests to support these enhancements.

Add analytics for mismatched container data and enhance container deletion logic
Introduce `link_table_mismatch.sql` for diagnosing data discrepancies between saved rows and the link table. Update `container_delete` logic to handle levels with missing links by listing saved contents for user clarity. Expand PostgreSQL tests to validate these scenarios. Improve filter syncing behavior in the main window and adjust `.idea` settings for database object filtering.

Add analytics for mismatched container data and enhance container deletion logic
Introduce `link_table_mismatch.sql` for diagnosing data discrepancies between saved rows and the link table. Update `container_delete` logic to handle levels with missing links by listing saved contents for user clarity. Expand PostgreSQL tests to validate these scenarios. Improve filter syncing behavior in the main window and adjust `.idea` settings for database object filtering.

Expand container deletion logic to handle serials at all levels
Refine `delete_container` to deactivate serials for containers, sub-containers, and emptied ancestors. Update tests to validate multi-level serial deactivation and adjust SQL logic for comprehensive container clean-up. Ensure robust handling of `tag_name` for better traceability.

Introduce `db_worker.py` for async DB operations and integrate off-thread execution
Implement `db_worker.py` to offload database calls from the Qt UI thread, preventing UI freezing during network round trips. Refactor related calls in `MainWindow` and `ContainerPanel` to run asynchronously. Introduce caching for repeated column and primary key lookups in `db/schema.py`. Update tests to validate async behavior, caching, and UI-thread result handling.
Tag serial changing with roll_no staging_serial_data

Add `DamageReportPanel` for reporting damaged serials and related database logic
Introduce `DamageReportPanel` to enable operators to flag serials as damaged, ensuring inactive status prior to reporting. Update database logic with `report_damage` and `serial_level` support, handling conflicts like active or unknown serials. Add tests for panel interactions, backend validation, and roll_no syncing in `serial_store_aio`.

Add `rework` permission check and update related user experience
Introduce an additional `rework` permission check in `authenticate` function and adjust error handling for restricted users. Update translations and modify UI labels in login and main windows to improve clarity.
tests adjustment
nssm root path on build.ps1
Auth adjustment + user management

Refactor admin role logic and add robust tests
Implement `is_admin_role` to handle normalized admin role checks, supporting variations like "super admin" and its variants. Apply the function within `MainWindow` for accurate permissions. Update EN/TH translations with "super admin" labels. Add unit tests to validate role handling and admin functionality across components.

Add tests for `serial_guard_pg` and `edit_history` functionality
- Introduced comprehensive test cases for renaming onto serials in PostgreSQL (`_test_serial_guard_pg.py`), ensuring inventory integrity and handling damaged or in-use rows. - Added `test_edit_history.py` to validate undo/redo functionality and handling of unsaved edits in grid views. - Updated `db` module with `SerialUnavailableError` definition for handling renamed damaged rows. - Adjusted test coverage to ensure controlled operations in temporary database tables.

Introduce audit logging, settings dialog, and corresponding tests
- Added `audit_log.py` for maintaining an append-only audit trail of operator activities with VM details and timestamps. - Implemented `SettingsDialog` in `settings_dialog.py` to centralize user preferences like language and theme with immediate application. - Created `tests/test_audit_log.py` to validate audit logging functionality, including session-based and explicit tagging, file handling for date changes, and resilience against unwritable locations. - Updated Thai user manual to reflect the new settings dialogue functionality.

Add damage reporting capabilities and corresponding documentation
- Introduced `damage_report_pdf.py` to generate and export damage reports as PDFs using `QPdfWriter` and `QTextDocument`. - Added SQL migration `add_is_damaged_at.sql` to include `is_damaged_at` column in `staging_serial_data` for tracking when damage is reported. - Created `tests/test_damage_report_pdf.py` to ensure accurate layout, pagination, and file export for the damage report PDFs. - Updated Thai user manual to clarify untranslated damage reporting interface elements.

Remove transfer lock restrictions and update documentation
- Removed `is_transfer` flag checks throughout grid save, delete, and rename operations. - Deleted `db/transfer.py` and `TransferLockedError` references to simplify validation logic. - Updated test suite to reflect the removal of transfer lock logic and ensure consistent functionality across all cases. - Clarified documentation to align with the updated behavior.

Remove shelved Thai manual file
- Deleted `.idea/shelf/Uncommitted_changes_before_Update_at_10_14_2026_10_35_AM_[Changes]/shelved.patch` containing an untracked Thai version of the user manual. - Cleared unintended shelved metadata.
